title: Vertical structure of a reanalysis Loop Current eddy
query: Using the provided GLORYS12 data for 5 August–15 November 2016 in the Gulf of Mexico (98–82°W, 18–30°N), investigate the vertical temperature and salinity structure of a Loop Current-region anticyclonic eddy.
adaptation: Public-data method transfer with reduced scope, authorized 2026-09-08; not exact reproduction of the original observational archive.
